verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs show it is driven by plain-language commands. It builds apps from descriptions, converts a site when you say "make this a mobile app," builds integrations you describe, restores checkpoints on request, and lets you build and ship entirely from an AI chat. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably across these tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Floot turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app
Take any website you've built on Floot and say "make this a mobile app."
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
Ask it to restore a checkpoint from before the change went sideways.
It lets you build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat
